children: CID HoldCo announced a trio of transactions to advance its strategy and strengthen its balance sheet. The company signed a binding term sheet to acquire Envoy Technologies from BladeRanger, issuing 10,833,333 shares (including Series C preferred valued at $6.00 per share) for roughly 67.3% of the post-closing fully diluted capitalization, with closing targeted for Oct. 6, 2026. To support liquidity, CID HoldCo raised $500,000 in cash via an unsecured $550,000 8% convertible note from H Capital, featuring a six-month term, a conversion price based on VWAP with a $0.50 floor, and ownership limits. Separately, CID HoldCo settled debt with LHT I by converting $1.09 million into 2.82 million shares at $0.386 and transferring certain assets, resulting in lien releases and a transition services arrangement.
